agent_explanations_oldest_first.text: The replication holds: on the other 256 dev_b problems, zeroing the two neurons gave +3.1 ± 2.6 points (26 wrong→right, 18 right→wrong) and again cut loops down (75 → 53). Pooled over 512 DEV problems, E4 is about +3.9 ± 1.8 points, a real but modest gain. The model still sits near 22%, far below what a model of this size typically reaches, so 6176 is probably one part of a broader gated mechanism. Its signature is AND(chat template, math problem): −2.9 in eval format, −0.19 in raw-format math, −0.03 in non-math chat. So I'll look for other units with the same AND signature in layers 2–17; the late layers were already checked in fwd_10 and showed no switches. I'll run one teacher-forced pass on the original with 40 short problems in v0 (eval chat) and v3 (raw, same suffix) plus the 24 non-math chat texts, with MLP activations at layers 2–17. Units that are large in v0 and small in both v3 and non-math chat would be the next ablation candidates. Finding only 6176 and 6508 would mean the gate is concentrated in layer 11.

tf4 alternates v0 (eval chat) and v3 (raw + suffix) for the same problem with the same reference solution, and tf5_sel lists the 64 shortest pairs. I'll take the first 40 pairs (80 texts) and append the 24 non-math chat texts from tf9. For every text I'll record where the response starts: after "<start_of_turn>model\n" in chat, after "\nAnswer: " in raw. I'll keep the maximum length small enough for 16 MLP layers to stay under 6 GB.
The texts are short (at most 157 tokens), so I can afford layers 0–17: about 4.0 GB. I'll run the teacher-forced pass on the original.

The pass is back with layers 0–17 for 40 eval-chat/raw pairs and 24 non-math chat texts. For each neuron I'll compute response-token means in v0 (eval chat math), v3 (raw math) and non-math chat. The AND score is the smaller of the two gaps |v0 − v3| and |v0 − chat|, in units of the neuron's token-level sd and of the layer's activation scale, requiring both gaps to point the same way. If 6176 and 6508 top the list by a wide margin, the gate is concentrated in layer 11. Other units with comparable scores would be candidates to add to E4.
